verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents tool/function calling through OpenAI-compatible tool specifications for building agents that call APIs and take actions, and it supports JSON-schema-constrained structured outputs. That covers the core of the story. Nothing in the pack shows parallel tool calls, multi-step tool loops, or how faithfully tool calls perform across open models. Missing for 10: documented parallel tool calling, documented multi-step/agent-loop tool use, per-model tool-calling reliability data, independent or hands-on corroboration that agent loops run without breaking.
